name: Haven
short: Reversible read-only lockdown with owner-delegated Administrator access
description: Temporarily restricts posting and reactions while preserving private-channel visibility, with a snapshot to restore original overwrites. No role removal or deletion.
end_user_data_statement: Stores guild permission-overwrite snapshots and IDs of owner-delegated administrator accounts to enable recovery and access checks.
install_msg: Owner can allow a trusted Administrator using [p]haven authorize @member, then [p]haven inspect, [p]haven seal and [p]haven restore.
